stories.title: Scope of devastation in Nepal continues to grow
stories.summary: The latest on the floods in Nepal, where authorities now say more than 4,000 are currently considered missing — a sharp rise from the previous figures.

stories.title: Second death confirmed in Grand Canyon flooding, search for survivors continues
stories.summary: Officials at Grand Canyon National Park are still assessing damage and engaged in recovery efforts from weekend flash flooding.

stories.title: Jurors deliberate in the trial of rap icon Tupac Shakur's killing
stories.summary: Attorneys on Monday gave their closing arguments in the trial of Tupac Shakur's killing. The rap star was gunned down in a gang-related drive-by shooting in Las Vegas in 1996.

stories.title: The producer who turns Edinburgh Fringe Fest productions into hit shows like 'Fleabag'
stories.summary: Before Baby Reindeer or Fleabag made it to the screen, they were small theater productions at the Edinburgh Fringe Festival. And behind both is a producer you've probably never heard of.

stories.title: What's the secret ingredient in these cookies? Plastic
stories.summary: New research at the American Chemical Society meeting showcased a potentially edible cookie made out of — plastic!

stories.title: He offered strangers $10 to tie his shoe. Then things got weird
stories.summary: A Minnesota man promised $10 to anyone able to find him and tie his shoe. That was the least strange thing to happen.
